faqSection.title: Frequently asked questions
faqSection.subtitle: Everything you want to know about the AI voice widget

faqs.question: What is an AI voice widget?
faqs.answer: An AI voice widget is an intelligent chat and voice interface that can be integrated directly into your website. It lets your visitors talk with an AI assistant that can answer questions, book meetings, and handle enquiries – automatically, 24 hours a day.

faqs.question: How do I integrate the widget into my website?
faqs.answer: It takes under 5 minutes. You get a simple JavaScript code snippet that you add to your website. The widget is compatible with every platform, including WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, and custom-built sites.

faqs.question: Can the AI widget book meetings automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes. The widget integrates directly with your calendar (Google Calendar, Outlook, and others) and makes sure new bookings land automatically, without you lifting a finger.

faqs.question: What does the AI widget cost?
faqs.answer: The starter package costs €134/month and includes 150 minutes of talk time. You only pay for active talk time – no hourly wages, no commitment.

faqs.question: Which languages does the widget support?
faqs.answer: The widget supports Danish and a wide range of other languages. The AI assistant automatically adapts to the language the customer speaks.

faqs.question: Is the widget GDPR-compliant?
faqs.answer: Yes. All data is processed in compliance with GDPR rules, and you have full control over which information is stored.
